OAuth 2.0 / Bearer Token.symptom: Long backfill dies mid-way when access token expires and isn't refreshed.

Pagination.snippet:
cursor = None
while True:
    page = get("/events", params={"cursor": cursor, "limit": 500})
    write(page["data"])
    cursor = page.get("next_cursor")
    if not cursor: break
Pagination.symptom: Offset pages skip/dupe rows while source data is actively updating.

Rate Limiting.symptom: 10 parallel workers × 50 pages/sec → IP banned for 24h.

Idempotency Key.symptom: Timeout on POST creates duplicate charges after retry.

Webhook.snippet:
# verify signature, then upsert by event id
assert hmac_ok(headers, body, secret)
upsert(event_id=payload["id"], payload=payload)
Webhook.symptom: Provider retries webhooks; mirror table doubles without event_id dedupe.

Polling vs Event-Driven.snippet:
# hybrid
# 1) webhook → near real time
# 2) nightly poll updated_since = watermark - 1h
Polling vs Event-Driven.symptom: Only webhooks → missed events during endpoint downtime forever.

API Contract / OpenAPI.snippet:
# openapi.yaml excerpt
Order:
  required: [order_id, total_cents]
  properties:
    total_cents: { type: integer }
API Contract / OpenAPI.symptom: Producer ships breaking JSON; 12 Airflow DAGs fail at 3am.

Versioning.snippet:
BASE = "https://api.example.com/v1"  # pin in config
# dual run v1+v2 during migration
Versioning.symptom: Unpinned client floated to v2 and renamed fields overnight.

Timeout / Retry / Backoff.symptom: Immediate retries from 100 workers turn a blip into an outage.

Synchronous vs Asynchronous API.snippet:
job = POST("/exports", {"from": date})
while job["status"] != "done":
    job = GET(f"/exports/{job['id']}")
download(job["url"])
Synchronous vs Asynchronous API.symptom: Airflow task times out waiting for a 2-hour export in one HTTP call.

GraphQL (Basics).symptom: Nested GraphQL extract hits complexity limit and returns partial data.

gRPC / Protobuf (Basics).symptom: Proto field number reused; old consumers read garbage values.

Change Data via API (Incremental Extract.snippet:
watermark = state.get("updated_at")
page = GET("/objects", {"updated_after": watermark - overlap})
state["updated_at"] = max(row.updated_at)
Change Data via API (Incremental Extract.symptom: Watermark advances past late-updated rows; incremental forever incomplete.

SLA / Quotas.snippet:
# budget: 50k calls/day → ~30 calls/min sustained
max_workers = min(config.workers, quota.safe_concurrency)
SLA / Quotas.symptom: Monday backfill exhausts monthly quota by noon.

Parquet.symptom: Wide SELECT * on Parquet is almost as slow as scanning a row format.

Columnar vs Row-Oriented.snippet:
-- columnar reads only needed columns
SELECT user_id, amount FROM events_parquet WHERE dt = '2024-01-01';
Columnar vs Row-Oriented.symptom: Lake bills soar because every query rewrites/reads full-row JSON dumps.

Compression Codec.symptom: CPU-bound jobs after switching all datasets to max-level Gzip.

Snappy / ZSTD / Gzip.snippet: # prefer Parquet+Snappy/ZSTD over .csv.gz for big scans
Snappy / ZSTD / Gzip.symptom: One 20GB .csv.gz file → single Spark task forever.

Row Group / Stripe.snippet:
# parquet.block.size / row group size affects prune + memory
spark.conf.set("parquet.block.size", 128 * 1024 * 1024)
Row Group / Stripe.symptom: Filters never skip data because each file is one huge row group of mixed dates.

Page / Column Chunk.snippet: # low-cardinality columns benefit from dictionary pages
Page / Column Chunk.symptom: String column of UUIDs bloats files — dictionaries don't help.

Parquet Footer / Footer Statistics.snippet:
# engines read footer first for min/max prune
# corrupt footer → file unreadable even if bytes remain
Parquet Footer / Footer Statistics.symptom: Query scans every file despite selective filters — stats missing or types mismatched.

Predicate Pushdown (Files).symptom: CAST(dt AS string) in filter disables partition/stat pruning.

Schema Evolution (Files).snippet:
# additive column: old files → null for new field
spark.read.parquet(path)  # merge schemas carefully
Schema Evolution (Files).symptom: Renamed column creates two half-null fields across history.

Avro.symptom: Analytics team scans raw Avro topics like a warehouse — I/O explodes.

ORC.snippet: CREATE TABLE t (...) STORED AS ORC TBLPROPERTIES ("orc.compress"="ZLIB");
ORC.symptom: Mixed Parquet+ORC lake confuses tooling and doubles reader codepaths.

Arrow (In-Memory).snippet:
import pyarrow.parquet as pq
table = pq.read_table("events.parquet", columns=["user_id", "amount"])
Arrow (In-Memory).symptom: Pandas read_csv of a huge extract OOMs; Arrow/Parquet path would prune columns.

CSV.snippet:
# ok for exchange; convert early
# sep, quote, escape, encoding must be explicit
CSV.symptom: Commas inside quoted fields shift columns; types inferred wrong every run.

JSON / JSON Lines (NDJSON).symptom: One giant JSON array file can't stream; memory spikes on read.

Delta / Iceberg / Hudi Data Files.snippet:
# data still Parquet underneath
OPTIMIZE lake.events;  -- compaction rewrites small files
Delta / Iceberg / Hudi Data Files.symptom: Blaming Delta for slowness when the real issue is 2M tiny Parquet files.

Splittable File.snippet:
# good: Parquet/ORC
# bad: single huge .gz CSV for parallel ETL
Splittable File.symptom: Cluster idle except one executor reading a non-splittable blob.

Partition Layout (Files on Disk).symptom: Partitioned by user_id → empty folders and unusable planning times.

Manifest / File List.snippet: # Iceberg/Delta track files in manifests instead of LIST /*
Manifest / File List.symptom: Hive-style dir listing dominates query time on large tables.

Bloom Filter (Parquet).snippet: # enable bloom filter on selective id columns (engine-specific writer flags)
Bloom Filter (Parquet).symptom: Point-lookup style filters still read most row groups — no bloom/stats help.

Encoding (Dictionary / RLE / Plain).snippet:
# low cardinality → dictionary + RLE
# unique IDs → plain / delta often better
Encoding (Dictionary / RLE / Plain).symptom: Unexpectedly large Parquet for enum-like columns written as plain strings.

Dimensional Modeling (Kimball).snippet:
-- grain: one row per order line
-- fact_order_line + dim_product + dim_customer + dim_date
Dimensional Modeling (Kimball).symptom: BI metrics disagree or cannot drill by the attributes users expect.

Star Schema.symptom: Analysts drown in joins or dashboards are slow — consider star (or OBT) for serving.

Snowflake Schema.symptom: Too many dimension joins for a simple dashboard filter.

Fact Table.snippet: fact: keys + measures at one declared grain
Fact Table.symptom: Counts and sums double or disappear after a join — grain/keys wrong.

Dimension Table.snippet: dim: surrogate_key + business_key + attributes (+ SCD cols)
Dimension Table.symptom: Same customer looks different across two marts.

One Big Table (OBT).snippet:
-- wide denormalized row for one consumer
-- order_id, amount, customer_*, product_* all in one table
One Big Table (OBT).symptom: One team wants a single flat table; enterprise shared metrics keep breaking.

Data Vault.symptom: Sources keep changing and rebuilding stars from scratch is too slow.

Hub (Data Vault).symptom: Need a stable identity across CRM + ERP without mixing attributes.

Link (Data Vault).symptom: Relationships (who bought what) need history independent of attribute changes.

Satellite (Data Vault).symptom: Attribute history from one source must not overwrite another source's fields.

Raw Vault vs Business Vault.snippet:
Raw = source-shaped hubs/links/sats
Business = rules, cleansed keys, derived sats
Raw Vault vs Business Vault.symptom: Business rules buried in the auditable raw layer — hard to explain lineage.

Inmon (CIF / EDW).symptom: Need one enterprise integrated model before many departmental marts.

Modeling Pattern Choice.snippet:
integrate: Vault/3NF
serve shared KPIs: star
serve one consumer: OBT
Modeling Pattern Choice.symptom: Team debates Vault vs star vs OBT — pick by layer and consumer, not fashion.

Cron Expression.snippet:
# min hour dom month dow
0 6 * * 1-5   # 06:00 weekdays
*/15 * * * * # every 15 min
Cron Expression.symptom: Job fires at the wrong time or dialect (5 vs 6 fields) is misread.

Crontab / Cron Job.symptom: Scripts race with no dependency graph or silent log failures.

Cron Timezone Pitfalls.snippet:
# Prefer UTC on servers; map to business calendar in code
# 0 0 * * * on UTC ≠ Eastern midnight
Cron Timezone Pitfalls.symptom: Wrong partition date or missed weekday runs around DST.

Overlapping Cron Runs.symptom: Two copies of the same hourly job write at once.

Cron vs Orchestrator.snippet:
cron = clock start
orchestrator = deps + retries + backfill + sensors
Cron vs Orchestrator.symptom: Fixed 6am job runs before upstream file arrives.
